question: What protection holds for the body even if bitten by great serpents?
premises: A person may be bitten by great serpents.
Poison is the agent in question.
Poison does not enter the body in that case.
inference: Even if bitten by great serpents, poison does not enter the body.
uncertainties: The source of this protection is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if bitten by great serpents.
